question: In a certain code language, GUIDE is written as 'KWMFI', and SLICE is written as 'WNMEI'. How will 'FAITH' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'GUIDE' is written as 'KWMFI',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591d7515bd98a4bd26d7a7c769907a472920f578edde8c3ad69514876b84a446.png] 

‘SLICE' is written as 'WNMEI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5acdee6d3062d0f5aa64d4d2b5118f036059c31ae6792079d48628f4351fa8f6.png] 

Similarly, for 'FAITH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eeffad500de9d7b8aba698667a688b5fbd441ea909950e35061767d4e0c68e90.png] 

So, 'FAITH' will be coded as 'JCMVL'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
